text:
{faith:sun}掌太阳、月亮与周而复始的秩序，西方蛮族信祂。奉祂时，一场里每换一次日夜，经验值再多给，有上限。献祭爱魔晶石、火焰、贵重品，以及体积正好为中的道具。日神赐福武器、防具与盾牌，赐福版激活即有急速，到了阶还省耐力。

奉了祂就有【日月】：进入战斗时是白昼，每 {faith_perk:sun:sun_cycle:base_sec} 秒换成黑夜、再换回白昼；白昼造成伤害提高 {faith_perk:sun:sun_cycle:day_damage}%，黑夜急速提高 {faith_perk:sun:sun_cycle:night_haste}%。进入对局和 {level:qual} 级各选一张日神的质变牌（日光浴、月光浴、日蚀、月蚀、残阳、斜月、星移斗转、日出当作、日落当息……），升级时还会出日神的基础牌，拉长或缩短白昼黑夜、加强某一边。二阶可以在神坛上祈祷，攒局内永久的火焰加成。

texts.en:
{faith:sun} rules the sun, the moon and the order that comes round again; the western barbarians worship this god. While you follow this god, each switch between Day and Night in a battle gives extra XP, up to a cap. The Sun favors Offerings of magic crystals, fire, valuables and items of exactly medium size. The Sun blesses weapons, armor and shields: a Blessed version grants Haste on activation and saves Stamina at higher Ranks.

Following this god grants Sun and Moon: battles start in Day, which turns to Night after {faith_perk:sun:sun_cycle:base_sec} seconds and back again; Day raises your damage by {faith_perk:sun:sun_cycle:day_damage}% and Night raises your Haste by {faith_perk:sun:sun_cycle:night_haste}%. At the start of a run and at levels {level:qual} you pick one of the Sun's Transformations (Sunbathing, Moonbathing, Solar and Lunar Eclipse, Afterglow, Setting Moon, Shifting Stars, Work at Sunrise, Rest at Sunset and more), and level-ups also offer the Sun's base cards that lengthen or shorten Day and Night or strengthen one side. At Rank two you can pray at an Altar to build a lasting Fire bonus for the run.
